evidence: Carries the 'TX fees and policy' label and modifies mempool policy flags under -acceptnonstdtxn=1.
rationale: Allows developers to test soft fork upgrades and non-standard script execution via the mempool on test networks without tripping standard script verify flags. It addresses a real testing friction noted in review ('would be nice for testing soft forks on test networks'), but is limited to testnets and reasonably deferrable.
